kaikki_vikisozluk.e: قَفًا • (qafan) m or f (construct state قَفَا (qafā), dual قَفَوَان (qafawān), plural أَقْفِيَة (ʔaqfiya) or أَقْفٍ (ʔaqfin, construct state أَقْفِي (ʔaqfī)) or أَقْفَاء (ʔaqfāʔ) or قُفِيّ (qufiyy) or قِفِيّ (qifiyy))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the root ق ف و (q f w). From Proto-Semitic *ḳapy- (“back of the head”), from Proto-Afroasiatic *ḳapay- (“back of the head”).
g: the back of the neck, the nape
